description: x402-poly-history: Price time series for a Polymarket outcome token: first/last price, change in cents and percent, high, low, average, direction, volatility. Takes token, interval (1m, 1h, 6h, 1d, 1w, max; default 1d) and fidelity (in minutes; the minimum is 10 for 1m and 5 for 1w). Other Polymarket services give a book snapshot; this gives where the odds have been.
name: x402-poly-history
